items.description: Mei Paranormies 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted guesthouse to investigate it for proof of the paranormal.Gesture Guesthouse was first built during the 1980s and is located in a prime area in California, US. Within 5 years of the grand opening ceremony, the guesthouse became very popular among the tourists all over the world. Many foreigners visited the guesthouse during the early 2000s. However, some tragic incidents occurred in the year of 2006. A murder took place in one of the rooms of the guesthouse. It was said that the man was killed by one of his friends after they had an argument. The man's spirit is often seen in some of the rooms of the property. The murderer in question got arrested the following day. During the same year, a woman died in the swimming pool of the guesthouse mysteriously. The investigation of the case was inconclusive and remains unsolved even today. A week after the incident, the woman's spirit was often observed in and around the swimming pool area. The owner of the guesthouse got in touch with Mei, the paranormal investigator, with the request to investigate the haunted guesthouse for proof of the paranormal and to help him out somehow. It was after he received complaints from the guests who stayed there that he decided to take matters into his own hands. You play as Mei, a paranormal investigator, and will you be able to help out your client?Key Features:Explore the entire haunted guesthouse located in California!Come face-to-face with the evil entities!Collect the various items like keys, wrist watch, etc.Avoid traps like fire, spikes, rotating blades, etc. Explore the spirit world!Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation.Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. items.description: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a solo paranormal investigator called Emi, who got a call from a client in order to investigate a haunted property called The Cold House, located just beside a cemetery in California, for proof of the paranormal.The Cold House was built during the 1800s just on the opposite side of a cemetery located in California by the owner, Tobey Cold. He, along with his wife Mary, lived there happily until the day something tragic happened. Mary accidentally fell down the stairs and died on the spot. It is believed that her spirit still lingers in that house. Later, during the 1900s, he sold the house to Mr. James, who was a popular singer at that time. But during the 1930s, he died in a car accident. It is reported that his spirit still resides in that house, and the sound of guitar playing is often heard.The house was then sold to the grandfather of Ms. Anna, the current owner of the house, who inherited the property after her father's demise. Since the 2000s, she has lived with her family in that house. They have been experiencing paranormal activities, which include furniture movement, an old guitar playing on its own, knocks on the doors, disembodied voices, weird noises coming from the basement area, dark apparitions, etc. So, Anna called Emi, the solo paranormal investigator, to investigate the property for documenting the paranormal activities. items.description: Clara Wraiths 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.Clara, the psychic, got a call from an owner of the hotel called Crystal Star, located in Texas, who desperately needed help with the increased paranormal activities in the hotel. It was built during the 1980s at a prime location. There have been reports of Satanic rituals taking place in one of the rooms on the third floor of the hotel during the early 2000s. Consequently, the spirit activity went through the roof, which affected the business. The owner shared his paranormal experience where he himself saw some weird transparent figures that roam through the hallway area of the hotel.The visitors who stayed in the hotel reported seeing the transparent figures and the dark shadow of a man and hearing growling and laughing sounds. Some have also experienced poltergeist activities in the rooms, some got scratched by an evil entity, and lots of other weird stuff happened inside the hotel premises. items.description: Zereoton Hauntings 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, went to the haunted apartment located in New York City for paranormal investigation. This apartment was built during the 1900s, which is said to be one of the most haunted locations in the US because of its dark past. During the 1980s, there was a brutal murder of a man named Lucas, which took place inside one of the rooms of the apartment. Around the same time, a woman wearing a white gown died while performing satanic rituals with her friends in the hallway area of the second floor. It was said that she was possessed by an evil entity who was responsible for her demise.The apartment residents have complained of seeing ghostly apparitions, and they often see the spirit of Lucas, the man who was murdered there. There have been reports of disembodied voices, growls, and whispers coming from the hallways and also from the basement area. The residents don't even dare to visit the basement alone because one of the residents got scratched while being there a few years ago. It was also said that the spirit of a woman wearing a white gown was often seen on the second and the third floors of the apartment.Mateo, while exploring the apartment, could feel as if someone was following him. The alien creature, Zereoton, has been following him since his last investigation and has even followed him home.
